question: 相近工作中，明确一般工作经历与职业／任务、行业经历要求是否呈现不同结构？未来观察进入者既往经历是否对应。
legacy_policy: T1–T6 immutable; new sample and estimates exploratory, informed by legacy results, not independent confirmation.
adopt: Separate experience condition from numeric duration
Three core experience objects; tools secondary
Fixed probability sample, no expansion by result sign
One finite AI-only review; no truth-accuracy claim
Work-group correspondence with distinct denominators when Individual becomes available

feasibility_rulings.Revelio_Individual: not acquired; no real R1-R3 or paired empirical plot can execute now; reuse existing interface, no additional fictitious field mapping
feasibility_rulings.bulk_inference: no configured model API; schema reuse and sample preparation executable; full10000 inference not claimed or simulated
feasibility_rulings.timeline: October7 sample/contract milestone executable; October14/21 paired results conditional on real data and extraction route, not unconditional promises

sample.A: existing GenAI-use candidate arm, software overlap allowed
sample.B: existing software-use and no detectedAI candidate arm; not certified non-adoption
sample.C: Restricted residual technology-candidate diagnostic in69 cells; broader occupation-background C not achieved
sample.existing_40300: preserved; A/B nested probabilities multiply stage probabilities; maintain positive inclusion in supported cells
sample.C_fallback: if full frame unavailable, report outstanding2000, never replace with convenient development ads or claim10000complete
sample.model_reclassification: keep original sampling arm and pi; new labels never overwrite frame; report any support loss

measurement.main_condition: applicant-facing prior_experience with strength required and unconditional scope
measurement.duration: Only explicit bound object+branch; no add across objects, alternatives or nested requirements; missing is not0; exact/minimum/range/stated-unspecified distinct
measurement.legacy_numeric_side_tables: may yield rule-based bound-year diagnostics; not semantic upgrade

bounded_review.sampling: fixed probability review stratified by originalA/B/C before viewing economic contrasts; includes negative and agreement cases, not just positives
bounded_review.disputes: material object/modality/number-binding only; preserve original readings; unresolved remains unknown
bounded_review.failures: correct mechanical serialization; semantic uncertainty retained or affected estimate withheld with denominator; no recursive parser redevelopment

analysis.primary: weighted descriptive experience-condition differences within fixed supported work cells
analysis.secondary: related-experience comparisons conditional on explicitly disclosed general years, not assumed total experience from domain/task years
analysis.years_handling: do not turn bare value into minimum or range into midpoint; summarize separate interpretation groups; no single ad total for incompatible branches
analysis.missingness: report disclosure and unknown by arm; complete-case years estimand is disclosed-year subset
analysis.uncertainty: respect stratified multistage inclusion weights and repeated employers; design-compatible employer-cluster procedure required before intervals; no conventional row-iid SE
analysis.fine_cell: actual within employer×verified occupation×region contrasts only where both arms present; membership in shared firms is not within-firm comparison
analysis.beta: occupation exposure and advertising technology role remain separate; use only verified frozen beta mapping; occupation FE absorb fixed occupational beta
analysis.joint_future: Dc advertisement requirement fraction vs Hc entrant background fraction in occupation×region, optionally verified employer cells; no subtraction as implementation rate; no same-quarter causal mapping
analysis.time: JOB_HASH URL identity not body version; first-observed cohorts diagnostic only; annual similar jobs not proof of historical body preservation

delegation.task: actual sample, executable scripts and bound-year aggregates

delegation.status: after output; if session agent limit persists root performs bounded acceptance only

stop_rule: Deliver actual sample/side-table increments once; no repeated old-table repackaging. Inference and Revelio absent inputs remain explicit dependencies, not completed jobs.
scope_correction_after_source_lineage_re: C is a residual within a prefiltered technology-candidate frame: any explicit GenAI use/develop or traditional-software use/develop (build_comparison_join.py line96). It does not cover all other advertisements in those occupations or ads screened out by the original technology rules. The proposed broad-background C target remains unmet; retain these2000 as a separate restricted diagnostic, without redraw.
